summary: Verified the Discord Scripted-Mode sandbox now uses instance-level Response Defaults (bot_instances.acknowledgment_replies + fallback_message) via _load_scripted_cfg. 5/5 pytest tests passed against Preview instance 8292460c-de40-4a28-a711-640c0ecb8447.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 3417 lines — reiterate previous recommendation to modularize into routers (chat/knowledge/admin/discord).
_load_scripted_cfg performs an extra bot_instances lookup on every scripted-mode reply; consider caching per-instance reply defaults if throughput becomes a concern.
GET /api/admin/instances/{id}/reply-defaults has a 'migrate from scripted_mode' fallback path that reads discord_config; once all instances are migrated, this dead branch should be removed.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests preserve/restore original saved reply-defaults (Glad to help!/No worries!/Anytime!/You got it! + 'Please contact support for further help.').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Instance 8292460c-de40-4a28-a711-640c0ecb8447 has scripted_mode.rephrase_mode=ai, primary_message='P', update_message='U'. bot_instances holds custom ack_replies=['Glad to help!','No worries!','Anytime!','You got it!'] and fallback='Please contact support for further help.'. Sandbox turn 3 for messages=['question','question','thanks!'] returns pool_name='ack' with intent='ack' and pool_considered subset of the custom acks. Clearing ack_replies via PUT /api/admin/instances/{id}/reply-defaults with [] causes fallback to DEFAULT_ACK_REPLIES.

test_results_detail.put_reply_defaults: persists new values, verified via subsequent GET
test_results_detail.sandbox_fallback_defaults: with empty acks saved, turn3 pool_considered ⊆ DEFAULT_ACK_REPLIES
